title: Editor Layout tour
description: A two-minute look at the main areas of the editor: what each panel is for and where to find things.

steps.title: Scene Tree
steps.text: Every object in the open scene is listed here. Click one to select it, and drag it onto another to make it a child.

steps.title: Properties
steps.text: This panel shows everything about the selected object. Add Archetype at the bottom gives it new abilities, such as a light, a collider or a Script Graph.

steps.title: Asset Files
steps.text: Your project's files: scenes, models, materials, sounds, scripts and Script Graphs. Drag them into the scene to use them.

steps.title: Editor Scene
steps.text: Your workshop. Hold the right mouse button and use W A S D to fly around, and press F to frame the selected object.

steps.title: The Quality menu
steps.text: Preview a quality level and change anti-aliasing, upscaling and render scale. The full settings are in Project Settings, Quality.

steps.title: Scene Viewer
steps.text: The game as the player sees it, through the scene's camera. Stats shows how fast it runs.

steps.title: Console
steps.text: Messages, warnings and errors from the editor and your game appear here. Double-click one to see where it came from.

steps.title: Play, Pause and Step
steps.text: Play runs your game in the Scene Viewer, Pause freezes it and Step runs a single frame. Changes made while playing are undone when you stop.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: The Help menu has the full User Guide, this tour and more tutorials. Enjoy making your game!
